items.title: Implement the TTY-preserving isolated launcher
acceptance: Interactive children inherit standard streams while ambient environment variables remain cleared.
Arguments bypass the shell and the exact child exit status is returned.
Only a conservatively validated TERM value extends the environment allowlist.
Fake-client tests cover environment, argv, terminal validation, and nonzero exit behavior.
Two disposable isolated homes safely probe installed agy 1.1.2 with --version only.
